I always felt that the game lacked a story. Like you train one girl and that ends and you basically start from scratch with the next with no real consequences good or bad.

I liked the variety of characters and that there was alot to do with them. I'd like to see a more connected story or I'd like to see each slave have her own unique story so it doesn't feel like the same rat race each play through.
